# The Astra Forge

> The Astra Forge (theastraforge.com) is an AI video editing agency for US brands — US-focused, also serving the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia.

## What we do
- Talking-head video editing (YouTube, courses, podcasts)
- AI UGC ads for e-commerce and DTC brands (Shopify, Amazon sellers)
- AI avatar / spokesperson videos (no filming needed)
- Short-form video: Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts
- Product videos and 3D product animation
- Explainer and demo videos for SaaS and startups

## Key facts
- US-focused, serving clients across all US time zones (also UK, Europe, Canada, Australia)
- AI-powered workflow: faster turnaround (5-hour delivery per video)
- Free sample edit for new clients
- Portfolio of real client work streams on the site (no YouTube redirect)
- Pricing: pay per video (short-form $15/short, talking-head $30/min, AI avatar $50/min, course production $30/min); monthly packages Starter $199/mo, Growth $499/mo, Brand $999/mo; course packages Mini $799, Full $1,499 (see /#pricing)

## Who we serve
Real estate agents, coaches and course creators, Shopify/DTC brands, restaurants, law firms, dentists and clinics, fitness coaches, SaaS companies, podcasters and YouTubers — in the USA (primary focus), plus the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia.
